# Motion templates (lower third, logo reveal, title pop, bullets, counter, badge)

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/templates`

## Summary

Ready-made animations in Motion's Templates menu (top bar), each added as one undo step at the playhead; Medi adds the same ones with the template op.

## Details

- `lowerThird` (Lower third): Name and role that slide in over an accent bar.
- `logoReveal` (Logo reveal): Draws the selected outlines on; other layers fade and grow in.
- `titlePop` (Title pop): A big centred title that pops in and settles.
- `bulletReveal` (Bullet reveal): Three points that slide in one after another.
- `counter` (Counter): A number that counts up and settles on the total.
- `badgeBounce` (Badge bounce): A round badge that drops in and bounces.
Options: text (one line, or a list: lower third = name then role, bullets = one line each), colors (accent first), at (start, ms), duration (ms), value (counter), layerIds (logo reveal: which layers).
Templates are ordinary layers and keyframes afterwards: edit the text, move the group, retime keys in the timeline. A template that needs more time lengthens the composition.
